_note: portal-contribution T3 (decision 128): the four supplier notices, mailed to the supplier's own contact address. A supplier has no Nextcloud account and is no party on these objects, so each rule addresses OpenRegister's `email` recipient kind, which follows `supplierRef` to the supplier (a system read bounded to the object's organisation) and mails its `contactEmail` after asking integriq (REQ-ERO-007, openregister build/dep-dossiq-email-recipient). The rule keys match the `notifications` list PortalContributionProvider declares for the supplier audience. The two date rules run on OpenRegister's daily scan and re-arm when the date moves (dedupe on the watched date).
